tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search upcoming public BileteLive events by text, city, artist, venue, category, or ISO-8601 date range.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Get public details for one BileteLive event by slug.

tools.name: get_ticket_availability
tools.description: Get current public ticket types, prices, and inventory for an event. Returns no customer data.

tools.name: get_table_availability
tools.description: Get anonymous table capacities and availability states for a seated event. Returns no reservation identity.

tools.name: get_artist_events
tools.description: Find upcoming public BileteLive events for an artist or performer.

tools.name: get_venue_events
tools.description: Find upcoming public BileteLive events at a venue, optionally narrowed to a city.

tools.name: get_event_booking_url
tools.description: Get the canonical BileteLive booking URL for a public event.
